name: Sales Invoice ID Rename
script:
old_name = frappe.form_dict.get("old_name")
new_name = frappe.form_dict.get("new_name")

if not old_name or not new_name:
    frappe.throw("Invalid parameters")

doc = frappe.get_doc("Sales Invoice", old_name)

# 1. Draft check
if doc.docstatus != 0:
    frappe.throw("Only draft invoices can be modified!")

# 2. Duplicate ID check
if frappe.db.exists("Sales Invoice", new_name):
    frappe.throw(f"Invoice ID '{new_name}' already exists!")

# 3. Copy doc with all data
new_doc = frappe.copy_doc(doc)
new_doc.name = new_name
new_doc.custom_external_invoice_number = new_name
new_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# 4. Transfer Attachments (Files)
frappe.db.set_value("File", {"attached_to_name": old_name, "attached_to_doctype": "Sales Invoice"}, {
    "attached_to_name": new_name
}, update_modified=False)

# 5. Transfer Comments / Timeline
frappe.db.set_value("Comment", {"reference_name": old_name, "reference_doctype": "Sales Invoice"}, {
    "reference_name": new_name
}, update_modified=False)

# 6. Delete old draft safely
frappe.delete_doc("Sales Invoice", old_name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response["message"] = "success"

name: Seal the Journal Entry Bypass For Supplier Advances
script:
# ============================================================================== # ENTERPRISE P2P COMPLIANCE GUARDRAIL: JOURNAL ENTRY VENDOR DEBIT VALIDATION # Target DocType : Journal Entry (DocType Event: Before Validate) # Purpose : Block unallocated debit entries (advances/payments) to Suppliers # unless exempted by Voucher Type or specific Employee Supplier Groups: # 1. 'Creditors ( Employee) Full & Final' # 2. 'IMPREST- EMPLOYEE' # ============================================================================== # 1. Define system/statutory voucher types exempt from manual P2P reference rules excluded_vouchers = [ "Opening Entry", "Exchange Rate Revaluation", "Deferred Revenue", "Deferred Expense" ] # 2. Define canonical exempted Supplier Group tokens (all lowercase, normalized punctuation) exempt_supplier_groups_canonical = [ "creditors (employee) full & final", "creditors(employee) full & final", "imprest-employee", "IMPREST - EMPLOYEE" ] # 3. Local request-level cache to prevent N+1 SQL queries on multi-line Journal Entries supplier_group_cache = {} # 4. Safely evaluate voucher_type at the header level current_voucher_type = (doc.get("voucher_type") or "").strip() if current_voucher_type not in excluded_vouchers: # Defensively iterate over the child table 'accounts' (Journal Entry Account) accounts_table = doc.get("accounts") or [] for row in accounts_table: row_idx = row.get("idx") or 0 party_type = (row.get("party_type") or "").strip() party = (row.get("party") or "").strip() # Only evaluate rows targeting a valid Supplier sub-ledger if party_type == "Supplier" and party: # Defensively coerce debit amounts using frappe.utils.flt debit_amt = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("debit_in_account_currency"), 2) base_debit_amt = frappe.utils.flt(row.get("debit"), 2) # Trigger compliance check only when debiting the Supplier if debit_amt > 0.0 or base_debit_amt > 0.0: # -------------------------------------------------------------- # STEP A: Check Supplier Group Exemption (With Caching & Normalization) # -------------------------------------------------------------- if party not in supplier_group_cache: raw_group = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", party, "supplier_group") or "" collapsed_group = " ".join(raw_group.strip().lower().split()) canonical_group = ( collapsed_group .replace("( ", "(") .replace(" )", ")") .replace(" - ", "-") .replace("- ", "-") .replace(" -", "-") ) supplier_group_cache[party] = canonical_group party_canonical_group = supplier_group_cache.get(party, "") # If the Supplier belongs to an exempted Employee group, bypass P2P block if party_canonical_group in exempt_supplier_groups_canonical: continue # -------------------------------------------------------------- # STEP B: Enforce Mandatory Reference Type & Reference Name # -------------------------------------------------------------- ref_type = (row.get("reference_type") or "").strip() ref_name = (row.get("reference_name") or "").strip() if not ref_type or not ref_name: frappe.throw( msg=( f"System Alert (Row #{row_idx}): Unallocated debit entries or advance " f"payments to commercial Suppliers ({frappe.utils.escape_html(party)}) " f"are globally prohibited via Journal Entry.

" f"You must link a valid Reference Type and Reference Name " f"(e.g., Purchase Order or Purchase Invoice), or process the advance via a " f"standard Payment Entry." ), title="Global Financial Compliance Violation" ) # -------------------------------------------------------------- # STEP C: Defensive Cross-Party & Document Status Integrity Check # -------------------------------------------------------------- if ref_type in ("Purchase Order", "Purchase Invoice"): ref_doc_data = frappe.db.get_value( ref_type, ref_name, ["supplier", "docstatus"], as_dict=True ) if not ref_doc_data: frappe.throw( msg=( f"System Alert (Row #{row_idx}): The linked {ref_type} " f"{frappe.utils.escape_html(ref_name)} does not exist in the database." ), title="Invalid Reference Document" ) # Ensure the referenced PO/PI is Submitted (docstatus == 1) if frappe.utils.cint(ref_doc_data.get("docstatus")) != 1: frappe.throw( msg=( f"System Alert (Row #{row_idx}): The linked {ref_type} " f"{frappe.utils.escape_html(ref_name)} is not in a Submitted state. " f"You can only allocate vendor debits against Submitted documents." ), title="Unsubmitted Reference Document" ) # Ensure the referenced PO/PI belongs to the exact same Supplier on the JV row ref_supplier = (ref_doc_data.get("supplier") or "").strip() if ref_supplier != party: frappe.throw( msg=( f"System Alert (Row #{row_idx}): Cross-party allocation violation. " f"Row Supplier {frappe.utils.escape_html(party)} does not match the " f"Supplier ({frappe.utils.escape_html(ref_supplier)}) on {ref_type} " f"{frappe.utils.escape_html(ref_name)}." ), title="Party Crossover Compliance Violation" )

Fetch document creator (Requester) requester = doc.owner # 2. Fetch Plant Head users based on unique Unit values across child table items units = list(set([d.get("unit") for d in doc.get("items", []) if d.get("unit")])) plant_head_users = [] for unit in units: role = None if unit == "Unit-1": role = "Plant Head U1" elif unit == "Unit-2": role = "Plant Head U2" elif unit == "Unit-6": role = "Plant Head U6" if role: ph_list = frappe.get_all( "User", filters=[["Has Role", "role", "=", role], ["enabled", "=", 1]], pluck="name" ) plant_head_users.extend(ph_list) # 4. Determine recipient list, subject line, and alert text based on workflow stage stage_headline = "" status_badge_color = "#0d6efd" if state == "Pending HOD Approval": # Stage 1: Notify Requester and mapped Department HOD recipients = [requester] + hod_users subject = f"Material Request {doc.name}: Submitted for HOD Approval" stage_headline = f"Material Request {doc.name} has been created by {requester} and is awaiting HOD review." status_badge_color = "#ffc107" elif state == "Pending Plant Head Approval": # Stage 2: Notify Requester, HOD, and relevant Unit Plant Head(s) recipients = [requester] + hod_users + plant_head_users subject = f"Material Request {doc.name}: Pending Plant Head Approval" stage_headline = f"Material Request {doc.name} has been recommended by HOD and is now awaiting Plant Head approval." status_badge_color = "#17a2b8" elif state == "Approved": # Stage 3: Notify Requester, HOD, and Unit Plant Head(s) upon final approval recipients = [requester] + hod_users + plant_head_users subject = f"Approved: Material Request {doc.name}" stage_headline = f"Material Request {doc.name} has been Fully Approved by the Plant Head." status_badge_color = "#28a745" elif state == "Rejected": # Stage 3: Notify Requester, HOD, and Unit Plant Head(s) upon rejection recipients = [requester] + hod_users + plant_head_users reason = doc.get("custom_reason_for_rejection") or "No reason provided." subject = f"Rejected: Material Request {doc.name}" stage_headline = f"Material Request {doc.name} has been Rejected.
Reason: {reason}" status_badge_color = "#dc3545" # Deduplicate recipient list and drop any empty/falsy values final_recipients = list(set([r for r in recipients if r])) # 5. """ # 6. Dispatch email immediately using Frappe email infrastructure frappe.sendmail( recipients=final_recipients, subject=subject, message=message, reference_doctype=doc.doctype, reference_name=doc.name, now=True )

name: Block Mixed PO Types in Purchase Receipt
script:
# Collect unique PO types found in the child table
po_types = []

# Iterate through all items in the receipt
for item in doc.items:
    # Only evaluate rows linked to a Purchase Order
    if item.purchase_order:
        # Fetch the PO Type from the parent PO header
        po_type = frappe.db.get_value("Purchase Order", item.purchase_order, "custom_purchase_order_type")
        
        # Add to our list if it exists and isn't already recorded
        if po_type and po_type not in po_types:
            po_types.append(po_type)
            
# If more than one distinct PO Type is found, halt the transaction
if len(po_types) > 1:
    mixed_types = ", ".join(po_types)
    frappe.throw(
        title="Consolidation Error",
        msg=f"Statutory Compliance Violation: You cannot combine multiple Purchase Order Types in a single Goods Receipt. Found types: {mixed_types}. Please split these into separate Purchase Receipts."
    )

name: Strict PO and Item Enforcement on PR
script:
# Server Script for DocType: Purchase Receipt # Purpose: Enforce PO presence and strict item-level cross-validation. # Engineered to ignore quantities and handle Subcontracting gracefully. # Defensive Check 1: Allow Return Receipts to pass naturally if not doc.is_return: if not doc.get("items"): frappe.throw("A Purchase Receipt must contain at least one item row.") # Cache dictionary to store PO items. Prevents database lag on large receipts. po_item_cache = {} for row in doc.items: # --- SUBCONTRACTING SCENARIO HANDLING --- # ERPNext v15 uses dedicated 'Subcontracting Receipt' DocTypes natively. # However, if your business uses legacy 'is_subcontracted' fields on the PR, # or custom subcontracting logic, we bypass the strict standard PO check for those rows. if doc.get("is_subcontracted") or row.get("is_subcontracted"): # Ensure at least SOME reference document exists for the subcontracted payload if not row.get("purchase_order") and not doc.get("subcontracting_order"): frappe.throw(f"Row #{row.idx}: Subcontracting receipts require a valid reference order.") continue # --- STANDARD PROCUREMENT VALIDATION --- po_no = row.get("purchase_order") # 1. Enforce PO Presence on the line item if not po_no or not str(po_no).strip(): frappe.throw( title="Procurement Policy Violation", msg=f"Row #{row.idx}: Item {row.item_code} is missing a linked Purchase Order." ) # 2. Fetch and Cache PO Items if not already in dictionary if po_no not in po_item_cache: # Query the database for all item codes present on this specific PO valid_items = frappe.get_all( "Purchase Order Item", filters={"parent": po_no}, pluck="item_code" ) po_item_cache[po_no] = valid_items # 3. Item-Level Cross-Validation (Quantity Agnostic) if row.item_code not in po_item_cache[po_no]: frappe.throw( title="Item-to-PO Mismatch", msg=f"Row #{row.idx}: Item {row.item_code} does not exist in Purchase Order {po_no}.

You cannot receive physical inventory that was not explicitly authorized on the Purchase Order." )

name: Opening PO Indicator For Each Item
script:
item_code = frappe.form_dict.get('item_code')
current_po = frappe.form_dict.get('current_po')

res = []
if item_code:
    conditions = """
        poi.item_code = %(item_code)s
        AND po.docstatus = 1
        AND po.workflow_state = 'Approved'
        AND po.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Closed', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled')
        AND (poi.qty - poi.received_qty) > 0
    """
    
    if current_po and not current_po.startswith("new-purchase-order"):
        conditions += " AND po.name != %(current_po)s"

    query = f"""
        SELECT 
            po.name as po_no,
            po.transaction_date,
            poi.qty,
            poi.received_qty,
            (poi.qty - poi.received_qty) as pending_qty,
            poi.uom
        FROM 
            `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
        INNER JOIN 
            `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = poi.parent
        WHERE 
            {conditions}
        ORDER BY 
            po.transaction_date DESC
    """
    res = frappe.db.sql(query, {"item_code": item_code, "current_po": current_po}, as_dict=True)

frappe.response['message'] = res

invalid_tokens = ("", "0", "00", "0000", "000000", "00000000", "-", "NA", "N/A", "NONE", "NULL")
item_hsn_cache = {}

for row in (doc.get("items") or []):
    raw_hsn = str(row.get("gst_hsn_code") or "").strip()
    is_all_zeros = bool(raw_hsn and raw_hsn.replace("0", "") == "")

    if (raw_hsn.upper() in invalid_tokens or is_all_zeros) and row.get("item_code"):
        i_code = row.get("item_code")
        if i_code not in item_hsn_cache:
            item_hsn_cache[i_code] = frappe.db.get_value("Item", i_code, "gst_hsn_code") or ""

        master_hsn = str(item_hsn_cache.get(i_code) or "").strip()
        master_is_zeros = bool(master_hsn and master_hsn.replace("0", "") == "")

        if master_hsn and master_hsn.upper() not in invalid_tokens and not master_is_zeros:
            row.gst_hsn_code = master_hsn
